children.name: title.tag
children.text: The world is not ending; it is being edited.

children.name: begin.tag
children.text: The world is not ending; it is being edited.

children.name: begin.yes.desc
children.text: Your current save will be erased.

children.name: diff.tag
children.text: The world is not ending; it is being edited.

children.name: diff.head
children.text: How should the story treat you?

children.name: diff.sub
children.text: This is fixed for the save you are about to begin.

children.name: diff.story.desc
children.text: Gentler. Enemies hit softer; crumpling costs nothing.

children.name: diff.normal.desc
children.text: The intended game. Crumpling costs Mnemosynth and restarts the room.

children.name: restart.note
children.text: You go back to the entrance and every puzzle in here resets: gates, plates, echoes and anything you were carrying for the doors. Rewards you already took, and lanterns you lit, are still yours.

children.name: binder.stat4
children.text: Quill damage   no change     Reach   no change

children.name: binder.stat5
children.text: Lantern burn   no change     Ink regen   0.0/s

children.name: Cards
children.empty: Nothing here yet. Cards are filed as you find them: Eraser Crumbs, Ink Vials, Bindings, and stranger things.

children.name: idx.detail.wit.each
children.text: Each point: +0.025 ink regen/s, -0.5% Lantern burn, and an extra try in Vault Trials every 20 points.

children.name: idx.detail.luck.each
children.text: Each point: +0.5% drop chances, +0.25% Mnemosynth found.

children.name: idx.keeps
children.text: The lantern will keep your place.

children.name: pf.help
children.text: Find the wrong word in the sentence. Pick it.

children.name: end.body
children.text: Thistledown is written in, and the Margin Gate stands open. Whatever lies beyond it will have to wait for the next chapter.

children.name: map.none
children.text: Light a lantern post out in the world, and you can travel to it from here.

children.name: map.foot
children.text: E   Travel (far posts only)          M   Close
